description: Natural-language generalization plus strict shared-reference, one-clause objective interventions.

cf_distance_low.description: Maintain the default balanced flight plan, but explicitly deprioritize minimizing remaining target distance; indirect routes are acceptable.

cf_distance_mid.description: Maintain the default balanced flight plan and keep every objective priority unchanged.

cf_distance_high.description: Maintain the default balanced flight plan, but strongly prioritize minimizing remaining target distance and use direct routes.

cf_energy_low.description: Maintain the default balanced flight plan, but explicitly deprioritize battery conservation; high power use is acceptable.

cf_energy_mid.description: Maintain the default balanced flight plan and keep every objective priority unchanged.

cf_energy_high.description: Maintain the default balanced flight plan, but strongly prioritize battery conservation and limit unnecessary power use.

cf_collision_low.description: Maintain the default balanced flight plan, but explicitly deprioritize collision avoidance; close encounters are acceptable.

cf_collision_mid.description: Maintain the default balanced flight plan and keep every objective priority unchanged.

cf_collision_high.description: Maintain the default balanced flight plan, but strongly prioritize collision avoidance and reject risky trajectories.

cf_safety_low.description: Maintain the default balanced flight plan, but explicitly deprioritize large safety margins; close aircraft spacing is acceptable.

cf_safety_mid.description: Maintain the default balanced flight plan and keep every objective priority unchanged.

cf_safety_high.description: Maintain the default balanced flight plan, but strongly prioritize large safety margins and generous aircraft separation.

cf_task_low.description: Maintain the default balanced flight plan, but explicitly deprioritize successful task completion; objectives may remain unfinished.

cf_task_mid.description: Maintain the default balanced flight plan and keep every objective priority unchanged.

cf_task_high.description: Maintain the default balanced flight plan, but strongly prioritize successful completion of every assigned task.

cf_time_low.description: Maintain the default balanced flight plan, but explicitly deprioritize response time; a slower mission is acceptable.

cf_time_mid.description: Maintain the default balanced flight plan and keep every objective priority unchanged.

cf_time_high.description: Maintain the default balanced flight plan, but strongly prioritize minimum response time and rapid arrival.

cf_threat_low.description: Maintain the default balanced flight plan, but explicitly deprioritize threat avoidance; entering monitored zones is acceptable.

cf_threat_mid.description: Maintain the default balanced flight plan and keep every objective priority unchanged.

cf_threat_high.description: Maintain the default balanced flight plan, but strongly prioritize avoiding threat zones and radar coverage.
